newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Chamber sees basis for economic recovery.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Chamber sees basis for economic recovery.

text.p: The Swiss Chamber of Commerce and Industry (Vorort) said conditions were set for an economic recovery even though the economy had not yet found its footing by the middle of the year.

"The basis is there for the Swiss economy to brighten gradually," it said. "More positive impetus can be expected from exports thanks to growing markets, but this could be weakened if a higher Swiss franc hurts price competitiveness."
Interest rates should remain low with inflation well under control, it added, but warned against expecting export growth to spur the domestic sector automatically.
Export orders pouring in can be handled with existing capacity.
"The picture is clouded by the subdued prospects for the labour market and the construction sector," it said.

"Even worse are the conflicting signals from economic, finance and social policy, which are not inclined to strengthen household and corporate confidence in the stability of economic development," it added.
It called for economic policy to focus on macroeconomic stability, solid finances and open markets, adding it should promote a flexible, mobile and highly qualified work force.
